summary: Briefing covers the 'blank label not opening / save+list all labels / could not create label' bug-fix verification. Wrote 6 new browser checks covering all create/open/persist UI criteria + 2 new backend test files (3 tests) covering the damaged-data resilience and validation-error API criteria. All 8 checks passed (0 bugs). Created/deleted only tscheck-/TA-prefixed fixtures; did not touch SAMPLE NMM, Bin & Shelf Tag, Coffee Bag Label, Apparel Hangtag or SAMPLE NMM's print queue job.

action_items.detail: Pre-existing backend tests test_tscheck_sheet_upload_xlsx.py and test_tscheck_sheet_upload_csv.py fail at session start because they depend on /tmp/brands.xlsx and /tmp/one.csv which don't survive across ephemeral /tmp (same issue noted in iteration_3). Unrelated to this iteration's acceptance_matrix (label create/open/save flow) and not touched/fixed here.

checks.name: create-blank-label
checks.evidence: New label -> starter-blank -> name 'TA Blank 1' -> Create: POST /api/templates returned 201 (width_mm=60, height_mm=40, elements=[]); label-tab-open-<id> and canvas-editor-container visible; zero 'Could not create label' toasts. Cleaned up via DELETE /api/templates/{id}.

checks.criterion: Create a label without typing a name
checks.name: create-label-default-name
checks.evidence: New label -> starter-blank -> left name input empty -> Create: POST /api/templates returned 201 with a non-empty default name, tab opened, no error toast. Cleaned up via DELETE /api/templates/{id}.

checks.criterion: Create a label from a starter template
checks.name: create-label-from-starter
checks.evidence: New label -> starter-price -> name 'TA Starter Price' -> Create: POST returned 201 with elements.length > 0, tab + canvas rendered the starter elements. Cleaned up via DELETE /api/templates/{id}.

checks.criterion: Created labels are saved (persist across reload, visible in Open label list, reopen shows the added element)
checks.name: created-label-persists-after-reload
checks.evidence: Created 'TA Persist 1', clicked add-text-button, save-status showed '● Unsaved changes', clicked save-template-button -> PUT /api/templates/{id} returned 200. page.reload() then open-label-button -> open-label-dialog -> searched 'TA Persist 1' -> template-card-<id> visible -> clicked open-template-<id> -> tab opened; GET /api/templates/{id} confirmed elements contains a type:text element. Cleaned up via DELETE /api/templates/{id}.

checks.criterion: Open label list shows ALL labels (count + search)
checks.name: open-label-list-shows-all
checks.evidence: open-label-count text matched GET /api/templates length (4: SAMPLE NMM, Bin & Shelf Tag, Coffee Bag Label, Apparel Hangtag); all 4 names rendered as template-card-<id>; searching 'Coffee Bag Label' kept that card visible and hid 'Apparel Hangtag' card (0 count). No open-label-error shown.

checks.criterion: Open a label from the list activates its tab
checks.name: open-label-from-list-activates-tab
checks.evidence: Clicked open-template-<SAMPLE NMM id> in open-label-dialog; dialog closed, label-tab-<id> and canvas-editor-container became visible (no pre-existing data mutated, read-only open).

checks.criterion: Damaged data does not break the list (backend)
checks.name: test_tscheck_templates_damaged_data_resilience.py
checks.evidence: Created fixture template via POST /templates (201). Inserted {id:'tscheck-zz-broken', name:'', width_mm:-5} directly via pymongo into the templates collection. GET /api/templates still returned 200 with the fixture template fully intact (backend log confirmed: 'WARNING - skipping invalid template zz-broken: [... string_too_short ... greater_than ... missing height_mm]'). Cleaned up broken doc + fixture template.

checks.criterion: Clear error message on create failure (API 422 + detail list)
checks.name: test_tscheck_create_template_validation_error.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/templates {name:'', width_mm:0, height_mm:0} -> 422 with detail list containing field locs ('name'/'width_mm') and non-empty msg text (string_too_short / greater_than). Companion happy-path POST with valid payload -> 201, cleaned up via DELETE.
